instructions_to_main_agent: Build a multi-page React application using React Router DOM for Home, About Us, Poojas, Packages, Events, Gallery, and Contact Us.
Implement the dark liquid-glass aesthetic with framer-motion animations, custom gold glowing borders, and smooth scrolling.
The floating WhatsApp button (+91 99194 03288) must be fixed across ALL pages with a pulse indicator.
Contact form on Home and Contact Us pages must validate user inputs and generate a pre-formatted WhatsApp chat link with booking details.
Include a dynamic Sitemap generator / XML output route and Google Search Console placeholder meta tag in index.html.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do not use transparent header backgrounds over content; use backdrop-blur glass with subtle border.
Keep typography high contrast: APCA compliant white/gold text on dark obsidian backgrounds.
Ensure every interactive element has hover states and micro-interactions.
Add data-testid attributes on all buttons, form inputs, links, and cards.
